pullRequest.title: feat(ui): add light/dark/system theme toggle and dark nav box
pullRequest.body:
## Summary
InvestTrack now supports a Light, Dark, or System-default colour scheme, so the app follows the user's preference and the OS setting by default. The theme is chosen with a button placed next to the existing privacy (eye) toggle in the header, and the choice is remembered between visits. The Home and About links now sit in a dark box, so they stand out on the page.

## Changes
- **Theme logic** (`ui/src/lib/theme.js`): pure, injectable helpers for normalising, cycling, storing and applying the theme. They set the `dark` class on `<html>` and handle the `system` option via `prefers-color-scheme`.
- **Pre-paint script** (`ui/src/layouts/Layout.astro`): an inline script in `<head>` applies the stored theme before first paint, which avoids a flash of the wrong theme.
- **Theme button** (`ui/src/components/ThemeToggle.jsx`): cycles Light -> Dark -> System, persists the choice under the `theme` key in localStorage, and updates immediately. It is added to the desktop and mobile header in `ui/src/components/Header.astro`. It has an accessible label naming the current mode, and it stays in sync across instances and when the OS setting changes while `System` is selected.
- **Dark styling**: `dark:` variants on the page shell, header and main components and modals. Tailwind is set to `darkMode: 'class'` in `ui/tailwind.config.mjs`. Global dark rules are in `ui/src/styles/global.css`.
- **Home/About container**: the links are wrapped in a `bg-slate-900` box with light link text, in both themes.
- **Tests** (`ui/src/lib/__tests__/theme.test.js`): unit tests for the theme helpers.
- **Docs**: feature and component lists updated in `README.md` and `ui/README.md`.

## Test plan
- `npm test` (cwd `ui/`): exit code 0, 53 tests run, 53 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped. The test run was executed by the factory QA step.
- `npm run build` (cwd `ui/`): exit code 0.
- Acceptance criteria from the execution plan were checked by QA, which returned a PASS verdict. These cover the OS light/dark defaults, the stored `light`/`dark`/`system` preferences, the pre-paint class, the live `system` update, the button cycle and persistence, the button placement in both headers, the Home/About container, and the theme colours.

## Quality gates
- **QA**: PASS (53/53 tests, build exit 0).
- **Code review**: APPROVED_WITH_SUGGESTIONS. Only minor polish items remain, and none block the change.
- **Security**: PASS, risk level NONE.

## Risks & rollback
- **Theme flash or mismatch**: the pre-paint script in `Layout.astro` is the critical piece. If it is removed or broken, the page may flash the wrong theme on load.
- **Initial toggle state**: the button starts in the `system` state and reads the stored value after mount, so its icon and label may briefly show `System` before the stored value is applied.
- **Colour coverage**: dark variants were added to the shell, header, main components and modals. Any component not updated will keep light colours in dark mode.
- **Rollback**: revert the commit. The theme is stored only in the browser under the `theme` key, so reverting leaves no server-side state. Stale `theme` values in localStorage are ignored once the code is reverted.

## Follow-ups
- Confirm the minor polish suggestions from code review, which the review summary did not itemise.
- The HTML pages under `docs/` (`index.html`, `privacy.html`) were not reviewed for theme-specific content.
- The repository has no CHANGELOG.md, so the change was not recorded there.
